records.action: Use disposable copied Sets and independently offered Start Recording on Scene Launch, eligible record-enabled tracks, configured selected inputs, an active independently recordable owned source and known-empty slots in the scene being launched. Record the actual transport, arm, input and preference states. First explicitly enable the preference and launch the matched scene to establish the genuinely productive recording baseline of RC-021, observing new clips actually recording in those empty armed slots. In a separate matched history with fresh empty slots and the same eligible active source/track/transport conditions, explicitly set Start Recording on Scene Launch Off and record its actual value; launch the scene alone without an additional Session Record, slot Record or Arrangement Record trigger. Inspect whether the empty slots record under the unchanged documentary comparator. Do not treat unspecified defaults as Off evidence. An unavailable control, ineligible or inactive source/track, nonempty slot or missing genuine enabled recording baseline is U, never a passing no-recording observation.
